nodes.title: Lyrics
widgets_values:
[intro]
Gather round, you sailors, and I'll tell you true
Of the Widow's Lantern and her forty crew

[verse]
We sailed out of Haddock on a cold grey morn
With the powder kegs dry and the sails new-sewn
Forty men aboard her with a harpoon apiece
And a purse full of gold if we brought back the beast

[chorus]
So heave, boys, heave, and the deep will give
Pull, boys, pull, if you want to live
Steel in your hand and salt in your eye
We'll fight what's below till the sea runs dry

[verse]
Three days out, the water turned black as the pitch
And the gulls all fled and the compass twitched
Then up from the dark came an arm thick as oak
And it coiled round the mainmast, and the mainmast broke

[chorus]
So heave, boys, heave, and the deep will give
Pull, boys, pull, if you want to live
Steel in your hand and salt in your eye
We'll fight what's below till the sea runs dry

[verse]
Old Barnaby charged with his cutlass held high
Took a hook to the ribs and was flung to the sky
But the bosun's harpoon found the beast's yellow eye
And the kraken went down with a thundering cry

[chorus]
So heave, boys, heave, and the deep will give
Pull, boys, pull, if you want to live
Steel in your hand and salt in your eye
We'll fight what's below till the sea runs dry

[verse]
We sewed up our dead in the sails that were torn
And we sang them to rest on that grim winter morn
Then a serpent rose up with its scales like a blade
And it wound round the stern where the dead men were laid
We fed it the cannons, all twelve in a row
Till it slid back down to the cold depths below

[bridge]
Then the sea went still, and the wind went dead
And the stars blinked out, every one, overhead
And the whole sea rose like a mountain of night
And the eye of Leviathan swallowed the light

[verse]
Our captain stood fast at the bow with a flame
And he called that old devil by its oldest name
He leapt with the powder, his lantern held high
And the night split in two with a fire in the sky

[chorus]
So heave, boys, heave, and the deep will give
Pull, boys, pull, if you want to live
Steel in your hand and salt in your eye
We'll fight what's below till the sea runs dry

[outro]
Now the Widow's come home with her canvas in shreds
Seventeen sailors, and the rest with the dead
So raise up a glass to the captain below
Heave, boys, heave
Heave, boys, heave
